note: Translating a Chinese question to English before retrieval REDUCES recall on this gold set. The generated Chinese questions embed English proper nouns verbatim and are shorter, so they are cleaner BM25 queries than the full English sentences. The asymmetry between B0 (raw query) and B1-B3 (translated) therefore favours the baseline, making any measured agentic gain on zh-TW a lower bound rather than an inflated one.
